design_description: The MEC jersey uses a bold red-and-white graphic identity, combining traditional football colours with an aggressive, deconstructed stripe treatment. The front is predominantly white but covered by large irregular vertical red shapes. Rather than conventional straight stripes, the red sections break into sharp points, elongated drips and fragmented geometric forms, giving the kit a raw, energetic appearance. The central red section begins at the collar and expands irregularly down the torso. The shoulders and sleeves are solid red, framed by white shoulder stripes and subtle white cuff detailing. A white crew-neck collar with red edging connects naturally with the central graphic. The MEC crest sits over the heart, with the Momuto mark opposite. The back deliberately becomes much cleaner: an almost entirely solid red field provides maximum clarity for the large white PLAYER 10 name-and-number treatment. This creates a strong contrast between the expressive front and functional back. Overall, it is a modern red-and-white MEC design that takes the idea of traditional vertical football stripes and deliberately breaks them apart into sharp, distressed graphic forms, while keeping the back clean and highly readable.
